aiDescription: Introduces a single large ship designed to replace obsolete fleets. It features 1st grade armor, super-durable hull, and over 200 speed with burn 18. The ship has monstrous flux capacity, 360-degree shield coverage, and numerous weapon mounts including small, medium, large, and missile slots.
